lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct vertical white stripes are visible across the torso; spacing is approximately uniform through the mid-section and tapers slightly toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 5th and 14th stripes (counting anterior-to-posterior) are abbreviated and do not reach the dorsal boundary; stripes 6, 7, and 8 terminate in fragmented spot segments at their ventral extremities.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3-4 distinct white spots is located on the lower posterior flank, situated between the vertical stripes and the right hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white spots are visible on the cheek and muzzle region; high-contrast white transverse bands are present on the anterior surface of the mid-cannon region of all four legs.
